item.title: Blue Owl Plans $513 Million CMBS for Amazon-Leased Data Center
item.description: Blue Owl Capital Inc. is preparing to sell $513 million of commercial mortgage backed securities to fund the acquisition of a Northern Virginia data center that’s fully leased to Amazon.com Inc., according to people with knowledge of the matter.

item.title: Mexican Peso Rout Deepens as Banxico, Fed Policies Diverge
item.description: The Mexican peso sank past the 19-per-dollar mark to its lowest in over a year, as the prospect of further Federal Reserve interest-rate hikes intensified a selloff triggered by Mexico’s dovish monetary policy.

item.title: NY’s Largest Mall Debt Now Controlled by Billionaire Namdar
item.description: The debt on Destiny USA, New York state’s largest shopping center, has been acquired by Namdar Realty Group, a Long Island-based real estate firm known for distressed retail real estate deals.

item.title: Latest Oil Market News and Analysis for Nov. 19
item.description: Oil prices swung amid concern that violence in the Middle East will re-escalate despite pressure on US President Donald Trump to pursue a diplomatic resolution to the nine-month war.

item.title: Latin America Currencies Sink on Rate Worries; Brazil Intervenes
item.description: A selloff in Latin American currencies extended to a second session on Thursday, sending the Mexican peso to its lowest since June 2025 and pushing Brazil’s central bank to step in to prop up the real, amid the mounting prospects for more rate hikes in the US.
